description: This file defines a Java class 'CHeaderConsumer' that implements the 'ConfigurationConsumer' interface, responsible for writing C header file content based on configuration structures. It includes methods to start and end the file, writing appropriate headers and include guards, and to handle the end of a configuration structure.

classes.name: CHeaderConsumer
classes.description: A consumer that writes C header snippets based on configuration data.

methods.name: CHeaderConsumer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the consumer with a BufferedWriter for output.

methods.name: startFile
methods.description: Writes the initial comments, include guards, and include directives to start a C header file.

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Writes the closing parts of the header file, including the end of include guards and footer comments.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles the end of a configuration structure by writing its header representation.
